services.name: Municipal Campground
services.desc: The Logan Lake Municipal Campground features 70 campsites. 63 RV sites featuring their own picnic table, fire pit, as well as 15 and 30 amp hook-ups ($32/per night). 2 unpowered designated tent sites and 5 unpowered RV sites are also available ($28/per night). A one-time $7 resort fee is applied to every stay no matter the length. Seven potable water taps are distributed throughout the campground which allows campers to fill up before parking. The sanitary station is on the edge of our town across from the Public Works Yard. services.name: Trail ride
services.desc: Logan Lake Community Forest and the District of Logan Lake are working together to develop a Trails Strategy to identify the strategic priorities that define the future direction for the trail network in the Logan Lake area. The existing trail network around Logan Lake is a prized community recreation asset. The networkincludes a wide variety of experiences, ranging from gentle community pathways to purpose-built XC ski and mountain bike trails to multi-day motorized excursions. Trails in and around Logan Lake are maintained and developed by different levels of government, the LLCF and by passionate volunteer- led organizations.
